# Research a topic

1. Read [topic package setup](references/topic-package.md) before changing package structure.
2. Read [source quality](references/source-quality.md) before collecting information.
3. Identify the requested `packages/topic-<name>` package or create it from the documented shape.
4. Research authoritative, current sources and record links adjacent to the claims they support.
5. Add or update Markdown, MDX, React components, and locally stored assets only within that topic.
6. Update the exported `TopicDefinition` when pages or navigation change.
7. Run the package's build, lint, and tests, then run the site bundle to verify integration.
